figs.name: psi-to-bar-gauge-vs-absolute-pressure-diagram
figs.alt: psig vs psia vs bar g vs bar a reference diagram from vacuum to atmosphere
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing gauge pressure measured from the atmosphere and absolute pressure from vacuum, with 150 psig as 10.342 bar g and 11.355 bar a.
figs.after_h2: Psig vs Psia vs Bar g vs Bar a
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>PSI to bar gauge vs absolute pressure reference diagram</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gauge vs Absolute: psig, psia, bar g, bar a</text>
<rect x="388" y="150" width="24" height="290" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="372" y1="150" x2="428" y2="150" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="362" y="142" font-size="17" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Air receiver at 150 psig</text>
<text x="362" y="168" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">164.7 psia = 150 psig</text>
<text x="438" y="156" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">11.355 bar a = 10.342 bar g</text>
<line x1="372" y1="330" x2="428" y2="330" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="362" y="322" font-size="17" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Atmosphere at sea level</text>
<text x="362" y="348" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">14.696 psia = 0 psig</text>
<text x="438" y="336" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">1.01325 bar a = 0 bar g</text>
<line x1="372" y1="440" x2="428" y2="440" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="362" y="432" font-size="17" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Perfect vacuum</text>
<text x="362" y="458" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">0 psia = minus 14.7 psig</text>
<text x="438" y="446" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">0 bar a</text>
<line x1="40" y1="440" x2="40" y2="154" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="28" y="300" font-size="17" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 28 300)">absolute, from vacuum</text>
<line x1="760" y1="330" x2="760" y2="154" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="775" y="242" font-size="17" fill="#b45309" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 775 242)">gauge, from air</text>
<text x="250" y="92" font-size="20" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">psi</text>
<text x="550" y="92" font-size="20" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">bar</text>
<rect x="60" y="486" width="680" height="48" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="516" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Same factor 0.0689476 for both; psig gives bar g, psia gives bar a</text>
</svg>

figs.name: psi-to-bar-transmitter-range-conversion-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to convert transmitter range from 0 to 500 psig to bar g
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the five steps to convert a gauge or transmitter range, with 0 to 500 psig becoming 0 to 34.474 bar g and 12 mA as 17.237 bar g.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to convert a pressure transmitter range from psi to bar</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Converting a Transmitter Range From psi to bar</text>
<rect x="30" y="62" width="330" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="195.0" y="100.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1  Read the nameplate</text>
<line x1="362" y1="94" x2="398" y2="94" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="400" y="62" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="99.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Range 0 to 500 psig</text>
<line x1="195" y1="126" x2="195" y2="158" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="160" width="330" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="195.0" y="198.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2  Convert LRV and URV</text>
<line x1="362" y1="192" x2="398" y2="192" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="400" y="160" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="197.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">500 × 0.0689476 = 34.474</text>
<line x1="195" y1="224" x2="195" y2="256" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="258" width="330" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="195.0" y="296.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3  Round sensibly</text>
<line x1="362" y1="290" x2="398" y2="290" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="400" y="258" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="295.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Match instrument accuracy</text>
<line x1="195" y1="322" x2="195" y2="354" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="356" width="330" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="195.0" y="394.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4  Update the DCS tag</text>
<line x1="362" y1="388" x2="398" y2="388" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="400" y="356" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="393.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 to 34.474 bar g</text>
<line x1="195" y1="420" x2="195" y2="452" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="454" width="330" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="195.0" y="492.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5  Verify on the bench</text>
<line x1="362" y1="486" x2="398" y2="486" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="400" y="454" width="370" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="491.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">12 mA = 50% = 17.237 bar g</text>
<text x="400" y="566" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Change the unit and the range together so the operator never sees a false value.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: psi-to-bar-conversion-formula-infographic
figs.alt: psi to bar conversion formula card with 100 psi, 150 psi and 16 bar examples
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the psi to bar and bar to psi formulas with key values such as 100 psi equal to 6.8948 bar and 16 bar equal to 232.06 psi.
figs.after_h2: PSI to Bar Formula and Bar to PSI Formula
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>PSI to bar conversion formula card with key values</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PSI to Bar Formula Card</text>
<rect x="30" y="62" width="355" height="110" rx="14" fill="#b45309"/>
<text x="207" y="100" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">psi to bar</text>
<text x="207" y="146" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">bar = psi × 0.0689476</text>
<rect x="415" y="62" width="355" height="110" rx="14" fill="#78350f"/>
<text x="592" y="100" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">bar to psi</text>
<text x="592" y="146" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">psi = bar × 14.5038</text>
<rect x="30" y="196" width="230" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="145" y="236" font-size="20" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">100 psi</text>
<text x="145" y="260" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equals</text>
<text x="145" y="290" font-size="22" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6.8948 bar</text>
<rect x="280" y="196" width="230" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="395" y="236" font-size="20" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">150 psi</text>
<text x="395" y="260" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equals</text>
<text x="395" y="290" font-size="22" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">10.342 bar</text>
<rect x="530" y="196" width="230" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="645" y="236" font-size="20" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">16 bar</text>
<text x="645" y="260" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equals</text>
<text x="645" y="290" font-size="22" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">232.06 psi</text>
<rect x="30" y="328" width="230" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="145" y="368" font-size="20" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">14.5 psi</text>
<text x="145" y="392" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equals</text>
<text x="145" y="422" font-size="22" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.9997 bar</text>
<rect x="280" y="328" width="230" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="395" y="368" font-size="20" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1 kg/cm²</text>
<text x="395" y="392" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equals</text>
<text x="395" y="422" font-size="22" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.980665 bar</text>
<rect x="530" y="328" width="230" height="112" rx="12" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="645" y="368" font-size="20" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1 psi</text>
<text x="645" y="392" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">equals</text>
<text x="645" y="422" font-size="22" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6.894757 kPa</text>
<rect x="30" y="466" width="740" height="56" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Shortcut psi × 0.07 reads about 1.5% high: 100 psi gives 7.0, not 6.89 bar</text>
</svg>
